description: This file defines the EmployeesController class for the SuiteCRM project. It manages employee-related actions such as editing employee details and deleting employees, including authorization checks and interactions with user records.

classes.name: EmployeesController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee-related actions such as edit view and deletion, extending the base SugarController.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the EmployeesController by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Handles displaying the edit view for an employee, with authorization checks to ensure only admins or the personnel themselves can edit.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion (deactivation) of an employee record, after verifying that the requester has appropriate admin permissions.
